validation.interpretation: Agreement validates replay reconstruction against these logs; not a claim of observed GPS, actual road accessibility, or unique historical route.

provenance.algorithm: Original prepare.py/data.py link projection and split + routing.py RoadRouter shortest travel time; no optimiser rerun
provenance.recorded: Service arrival/completion times, vehicle assignments, passenger/cargo postservice states, travel distance/time
provenance.reconstructed: Ordered road geometry between logged endpoints; within-link position interpolated by directed edge travel time
provenance.virtual: PARK_SEARCH contributes logged accounting distance/time but stays at the last service node
provenance.animation: Door, trunk, walking and box motions are illustrative choreography during logged service intervals
provenance.costs: Electricity: total logged distance × 0.256kWh/km × 295KRW/kWh; includes virtual parking distance. S2 optimiser weights remain provisional.

costAssumptions.scope: User-supplied annual estimates for integrated operation only; not actual costs or confirmed S2 optimisation coefficients
